info.title: Speaking Meeting Bot API
info.description: API for deploying AI-powered speaking agents in video meetings. Combines MeetingBaas for meeting connectivity with Pipecat for voice AI processing.

post.description:
Create and deploy a speaking bot in a meeting.

Launches an AI-powered bot that joins a video meeting through MeetingBaas
and processes audio using Pipecat's voice AI framework.

201.description: Bot successfully created and joined the meeting

400.description: Bad request - Missing required fields or invalid data

500.description: Server error - Failed to create bot through MeetingBaas API

delete.description:
Remove a bot from a meeting by its ID.

This will:
1. Call the MeetingBaas API to make the bot leave
2. Close WebSocket connections if they exist
3. Terminate the associated Pipecat process

schema.title: Response Leave Bot Bots  Bot Id  Delete

400.description: Bad request - Missing required fields or identifiers

404.description: Bot not found - No bot with the specified ID

500.description: Server error - Failed to remove bot from MeetingBaas API

llm_api_key.title: Llm Api Key
llm_api_key.description: API key for the LLM provider selected by llm_provider (OpenAI, Anthropic or Z.ai).

BotCredentials.title: BotCredentials
BotCredentials.description:
Bring-your-own provider keys for one bot.

Every field is optional; a key that is not supplied falls back to the
server's own configuration. Keys are handed to this bot's pipeline process
only, are never written to disk or logs, and are never returned by the API.

meeting_url.title: Meeting Url
meeting_url.description: URL of the Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams meeting to join

bot_name.title: Bot Name
bot_name.description: Name to display for the bot in the meeting

personas.title: Personas
personas.description: List of persona names to use. The first available will be selected.

websocket_url.title: Websocket Url
websocket_url.description: Optional public WebSocket base URL override, e.g. wss://bot.example.com

prompt_data_sources.title: Prompt Data Sources
prompt_data_sources.description: External text or URL data sources to append to the bot prompt

prompt_data_token_limit.title: Prompt Data Token Limit
prompt_data_token_limit.description: Approximate total token cap for loaded prompt_data_sources. 0 disables loading.

mcp.description: MCP server/tool metadata and optional live connection details

mcp_profile.title: Mcp Profile
mcp_profile.description: Optional trusted local mcpproxy group preset. 'professional' connects to MCP_PROXY_PROFESSIONAL_URL or http://127.0.0.1:8111/mcp; 'personal' connects to MCP_PROXY_PERSONAL_URL or http://127.0.0.1:8110/mcp; 'all' connects to MCP_PROXY_ALL_URL or http://127.0.0.1:8109/mcp. The preset is merged with explicit mcp servers when both are supplied.

mcp_profile_tool_access.title: Mcp Profile Tool Access
mcp_profile_tool_access.description: Tool exposure for mcp_profile presets. 'read_only' exposes retrieve_tools, call_tool_read, read_cache, and set_profile. 'read_write' also exposes call_tool_write. Presets never expose upstream_servers, call_tool_destructive, code_execution, registry, or quarantine tools.

llm_provider.title: Llm Provider
llm_provider.description: LLM provider for this bot. Defaults to LLM_PROVIDER, then openai.

llm_model.title: Llm Model
llm_model.description: Provider model for this bot. Defaults to provider-specific env vars.

speech_speed.title: Speech Speed
speech_speed.description: TTS speaking speed multiplier. Honored range is 0.6-1.5 (the runner clamps to it); values outside are rejected. Defaults to CARTESIA_TTS_SPEED, TTS_SPEED, SPEECH_SPEED, or the runner default.

speech_volume.title: Speech Volume
speech_volume.description: TTS loudness multiplier. Honored range is 0.5-2.0 (Cartesia sonic-3). Omit for the provider default.

speech_emotion.title: Speech Emotion
speech_emotion.description: Emotion tag guiding the TTS tone (Cartesia sonic-3, experimental; 60+ tags such as 'excited', 'calm'). Omit to let the model infer tone from the text, which Cartesia recommends.

respond_mode.title: Respond Mode
respond_mode.description: When the bot replies. 'always': every completed turn gets an answer (good for 1:1 calls). 'mentioned': the bot only hears turns within a short window after someone says its name — the mode for multi-party meetings where it should stay quiet until addressed.

credentials.description: Bring your own provider keys for this bot (LLM, speech-to-text, text-to-speech). Any key left out falls back to the server's own configuration. Keys are used only by this bot's pipeline and are never stored or returned.

transcription_enabled.title: Transcription Enabled
transcription_enabled.description: Have MeetingBaas transcribe the recording once the meeting ends, with the bot's own turns attributed to it by name. Set false for a recording without a transcript.

transcription_provider.title: Transcription Provider
transcription_provider.description: MeetingBaas speech-to-text provider for that transcript.

tool_allowlist.title: Tool Allowlist
tool_allowlist.description: Optional allowlist of MCP tool names this bot may call from this server.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Optional per-server connection/tool timeout in seconds.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Operator instructions or constraints for this MCP server

characteristics.description: List of specific characteristics or features of the persona

text.title: Text

token_limit.title: Token Limit
token_limit.description: Optional per-source token cap before the request-level cap is applied

PromptDataSource.title: PromptDataSource
PromptDataSource.description: External context to append to the bot prompt under a token budget.

start_secs.title: Start Secs
start_secs.description: Sustained speech (seconds) before a turn registers while the bot is silent; while it speaks, min_interrupt_words decides

stop_secs.title: Stop Secs
stop_secs.description: Silence (seconds) before the bot checks whether the speaker is done; it replies right away when they are

unfinished_pause_secs.title: Unfinished Pause Secs
unfinished_pause_secs.description: When the speaker sounds mid-thought, silence (seconds) after which the bot replies anyway

min_interrupt_words.title: Min Interrupt Words
min_interrupt_words.description: Words someone must say before they interrupt the bot mid-sentence; coughs and 'uh-huh's stay below it. 0 interrupts on any speech

TurnConfig.title: TurnConfig
TurnConfig.description:
Per-bot turn-taking tuning.

All fields optional; unset fields fall back to the VAD_* / TURN_* env
vars, then the server defaults (0.2 s stop, 1.5 s unfinished pause). A
local end-of-turn model decides whether the speaker has finished once the
VAD reports a pause, so stop_secs only needs to catch the pause.
Human-facing bots want the defaults; bot-vs-bot meetings want patience
(higher start_secs and unfinished_pause_secs) so the bots stop barging in
on each other.
